data.name: WarningRestart.Text
data.value: Saving web.config restarts the site, so users will be signed out and the first page load will be slow.

data.name: WarningKey.Text
data.value: The default RSA provider keeps its key in this server's machine key container. The file can only be decrypted on this server unless the key is exported to the others (aspnet_regiis -px / -pi). The DataProtection provider is tied to this machine outright.

data.name: WarningDnn.Text
data.value: DNN's installer and upgrade routines edit web.config as plain XML, so decrypt both sections before upgrading DNN or installing extensions that change them.

data.name: WarningBackup.Text
data.value: Each change first copies web.config to App_Data\ConfigBackups. That copy holds the plain text values from before an encryption, so delete it once you have confirmed the site still works.

data.name: EncryptConfirm.Text
data.value: Encrypt the {0} section of web.config? The site will restart.

data.name: DecryptConfirm.Text
data.value: Decrypt the {0} section of web.config? Its values will be stored as plain text and the site will restart.

data.name: ERROR_Generic.Text
data.value: The change could not be made. See the DNN event log for details.

data.name: ERROR_Load.Text
data.value: Could not read the web.config sections.
